name: MODELLER
summary: Template-based comparative protein structure modeling with spatial restraints.

steps: Review the maintainer's MODELLER 10.8 download page and license terms. Academic non-profit users must register for their own free license key; government and commercial users need the appropriate licensing route.

Have the user obtain the official package for the actual OS/CPU (conda, installer, RPM/DEB or tarball as appropriate). Verify a published GPG signature where available. Do not share, embed or commit license keys or redistribute the program.

Follow the official platform installation guide in a user-controlled environment, enter the license key through the maintainer-supported local mechanism, and keep the key out of logs and agent transcripts.
Run an official local tutorial example with user-approved template input. Confirm the installed version and license validity without uploading private sequences or claiming model accuracy.
install.verify_note: Use the selected MODELLER 10.8 installation guide and local tutorial after the user's license is configured. A Python import alone is not enough to prove the license or modeling workflow works.

notes: Academic use is free of charge only under the maintainer's terms and requires a user-specific license. This repository neither distributes MODELLER nor stores a license key. Comparative modeling requires an appropriate template and alignment; it is not de novo folding.
